objective: Produce a bounded architecture assessment for Survey/Questionnaire Data Acquisition and future SEM support without adding implementation scope to PR #44
instructions: Do not implement Google Forms, survey runtime, DoE, bias verification, SEM, KU2A UI, or new production integration in PR #44.

Inspect the current KU2D/KU2A architecture and identify where user-generated survey/questionnaire acquisition should sit relative to public Internet acquisition, uploaded files, existing-system connectors, and KU2A dataset intake.

Assess a staged survey workflow from simple Excel question-bank upload to generated Google Form, response linkage, collection-progress dashboard, automatic analysis, and the advanced case where the user starts only with a research/business question and the system recommends whether a questionnaire is appropriate.

Define conceptual contracts for questionnaire specification, question/answer types, constructs/scales, consent/privacy metadata, sampling frame, response provenance, collection status, bias/quality diagnostics, and dataset handoff. Preserve human review before publishing a form.

Explain how DoE/experimental-design concepts relate to, but differ from, questionnaire/survey design; identify where randomization, treatment assignment, sampling design, nonresponse, selection bias, common-method bias, wording/order effects, and measurement validity belong.
Propose how Google Forms should be treated as one connector/provider behind a generic Survey Collection Provider contract so other providers can be added later.

Propose the future SEM analysis placement in KU2A, including measurement model, latent constructs, CFA, structural model, fit indices, reliability/validity diagnostics, mediation/moderation where appropriate, and prerequisites from questionnaire metadata without implementing SEM now.

Identify the minimum shared metadata that should flow from questionnaire design/acquisition into KU2A so later SEM can understand constructs, indicators, reverse-coded items, scale types, missingness, respondent IDs, grouping variables, and sampling/design information.
Assess privacy/authorization boundaries for Google account connection and survey responses; do not request credentials or add any live connector.
Recommend a phased roadmap and branch/PR boundaries. Keep Learning Memory and Agent Handoff infrastructure logically separate from survey respondent data.
Return KU2D-R-000002 and update the coordination queue so next_action.actor=assistant. Make no live request and no unrelated code change.

expected_result.deliverable: architecture assessment and phased implementation recommendation only

provenance.source_context: User requested future questionnaire/survey acquisition from simple question upload through assisted design, Google Form generation, response dashboards, bias/DoE verification, plus future SEM analysis in KU2A.
